chapters.title: Vectors
content: Example 1: A man walks 6 km south-west and then 4 km due west. How far, and in what direction, is he then from his starting point?

chapters.title: Force and Newton's laws
content: Example 3: A body of mass 8 kg is acted upon by a force of 10 N. Find the acceleration.

chapters.title: Moments
content: Example 3: Three forces acting on a body have moments of 15 Nm clockwise, 10 Nm anticlockwise and 13 Nm clockwise, about a point X. Find the sum of these moments in magnitude and direction.
